reading_note: The arc describes the Lord's operative Divine Truth, having ordered the heavens and the world of spirits, then purifying the natural mind through three formative works: (1) the wheel/sphere winnowing falsities and burdens out of the firmaments; (2) the binding of the dragon (ruling falsity from self-love) into the natural sea, fastening its powers so they cannot ascend; (3) the natural sea becoming the receptacle (pandocheion) into which all evils, falsities, and transformations are gathered. The driving image is purification by separation: the Living Spirit casts down what is impure, seals the stars/zodiac (states of truth in order) into the natural by representation, and the sea-form becomes a body in which the impure is held and processed back toward the Height.
